create_inline_vlm_options: create InlineVlmOptions to configure an inline VLM model with repo_id, inference framework, and response format
create_api_vlm_options: create ApiVlmOptions to configure an external API-based VLM model with URL, headers, and response format
build_response_format_enum: build a ResponseFormat enum to specify output format as doctags, markdown, or html for VLM inference
build_inference_framework_enum: build an InferenceFramework enum to select between mlx and transformers for VLM model execution
create_transformers_model_type_enum: create a TransformersModelType enum to choose automodel, automodel-vision2seq, or automodel-causallm
